params.caption: 🎮 FF7 Revelation brings back snowboarding and Queen's Blood Director Naoki Hamaguchi says the snowboarding minigame returns in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, the last chapter of the remake trilogy, calling it essential. The Queen's Blood card game is also coming back because fans asked for it. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 17:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #FinalFantasy #FF7 #GamingNews
